newsitem.title: FINLAND: UPM TO RESHUFFLE FINNYARDS LOANS.
newsitem.headline: UPM TO RESHUFFLE FINNYARDS LOANS.

text.p: Finnish forest industry group UPM-Kymmene Oy will transform 130 million markka of loans to shipyard Finnyards from its books into subordinated loans held by an associated company, Finnyards said on Thursday.
"There will be no result impact for UPM-Kymmene," UPM's vice president Martin Granholm told a news conference.
"In addition, the State of Finland decided to continue as one of Finnyards' shareholders until the year 2000," Finnyards said.
Granholm said the troubled shipyard would now be able to continue its operations.
Before the debt restructuring UPM was Finnyards' largest owner with a 48 percent stake. The government owned 13 percent and Finnish shipping company Hollming owned 39.1 percent.
